summary: A year after the National Guard deployment in Washington, D.C., statehood advocates are highlighting federal control of the District as a central argument for why statehood is urgently needed. The headlines also reflect ongoing efforts to defend D.C.'s fiscal independence against what advocates describe as federal attacks on local governance. These developments underscore tensions between local D.C. authority and federal oversight that continue to shape the statehood debate.
